items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Implements the ticket exactly (shared 6000-char maxLength on `detail` in triage_item.schema.json + enforced in append_triage_item); also closed the append_triage_item_idempotent and amend paths, which write the same field and would otherwise bypass the cap.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: New ValueError guard mirrors the existing check_optional_str/check_amend_title pattern; verified all 4 producers with unbounded detail construction already wrap the append call in broad except Exception (best-effort, non-blocking), so no crash risk introduced.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No user input reaches SQL/HTML; this is a data-length boundary guard only.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Boundary tests (at-cap accepted / one-over rejected) added for append, append_idempotent, amend, and schema-level negative validation; all assert on outcomes, not internals.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: No loops beyond a fixed 3-item tuple; no N+1, no unbounded work introduced.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: check_detail_length mirrors check_optional_str; DETAIL_MAX_LEN mirrors SEVERITIES/KINDS. triage.py stayed at its exact pinned 882-line bloat-baseline ceiling via net-zero swaps; test_triage_schema.py stayed at its pinned 558 lines, new tests homed in test_triage_amend_schema.py per that file's documented convention.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Producer: triage.append_triage_item / append_triage_item_idempotent / triage.amend_triage_item. Consumer: triage.read_all_items, triage_cli.py, WebUI Triage tab. Round-trip probe: test_append_accepts_detail_at_cap writes a full at-cap event to disk and re-validates it against the schema.
